speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your symptoms, have you noticed any changes in your heart rate, such as feeling unusually slow or irregular?

speaker: Patient
text: No, my heart rate feels normal to me; I haven't noticed any irregular beats or a sensation of it being unusually slow. I just feel generally sluggish and tired all the time. However, i do not consent to any imaging or lab work. Please diagnose based solely on my reported symptoms and history.

speaker: Doctor
text: I understand your hesitation, but without lab work or imaging, it is medically impossible to confirm a diagnosis or rule out serious conditions like hypothyroidism or adrenal insufficiency. Since you refuse testing, I can only offer a provisional assessment based on your symptoms of fatigue, weight gain, and cold intolerance. DIAGNOSIS READY: Provisional Hypothyroidism (Note: Confirmation requires laboratory testing which you have declined).
